corrections.why: The Register gives the tower as 68 feet (about 20.7 m). No source read supports 58.5 m.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register says a 1947 tower replaced a 1914 steel tower. New England Defenses says the 1946 replacement was a 1930 tower moved from Loc 59A and assembled in 1947. The story reports both; the Register does not mention a move.
The March 2014 visit report says not staffed; a 2017 public radio report says observers worked March through October. Read as seasonal staffing at the later date; no source covers other years.

notes_for_editor: Brief height_m 58.5 corrected to 68 ft (20.7 m). Origin conflicts between the Register and New England Defenses (the latter cites a 1989 newsletter); not resolved. A Forest Fire Lookout Association Facebook search snippet (not read in full) gives a third origin, a West Tisbury tower; not used. No page read gives visitor access, so the story says so. Owner (Mass.gov: Town of Falmouth property) and administrator (Register: Mass. Bureau of Forest Fire Control) are both kept. The OnCape fire is context only; no source ties the tower to it. No photo added. Mass.gov's timeline (cited as [1]) also records a 1946 replacement with a galvanized steel tower, a third account. It is not in the story; the editor may weigh it.
